# netbox_rack_group (Data Source)

A NetBox rack group (dcim.rackgroup): an arbitrary grouping of racks, independent of the location hierarchy.

From the [official documentation](https://netboxlabs.com/docs/netbox/models/dcim/rackgroup/):

> Racks can optionally be assigned to rack groups to reflect their physical placement. Rack groups provide a secondary means of categorization alongside [locations](https://netboxlabs.com/docs/netbox/models/dcim/location/), which is particularly useful for datacenter operators who need to group racks by row, aisle, or similar physical arrangement while keeping them assigned to the same location, such as a cage or room. Rack groups are flat and do not form a hierarchy.
>
> Rack groups can also be used to scope [VLAN groups](https://netboxlabs.com/docs/netbox/models/ipam/vlangroup/), which can help model L2 domains spanning rows or pairs of racks.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "netbox_rack_group" "test" {
  name = "test-rack_group"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `custom_field_filters` (Map of String) Custom field values to match, by field name, e.g. { tier = "gold" }: each entry filters as cf_<field name> with the field's own filter logic, loose (case-insensitive substring) or exact.
- `id` (Number) NetBox id.
- `name` (String)
- `name_contains` (String) Case-insensitive substring of the name.
- `owner_id` (Number) Id of the owner the object is assigned to.
- `slug` (String) URL-friendly unique shorthand; derived from name when not set.
- `tag_slug` (String) Slug of a tag the object carries.

### Read-Only

- `comments` (String)
- `created` (String)
- `custom_fields` (Map of String) Custom field values by field name. Every value is a string; NetBox coerces numbers and booleans. A key removed from the map is cleared in NetBox (set {} to clear all).
- `description` (String)
- `last_updated` (String)
- `rack_count` (Number) Number of racks in the rack group.
- `tags` (Set of String) Slugs of the tags assigned to the object (the provider's default_tags are added on top, see tags_all).
- `tags_all` (Set of String) Slugs of all tags on the object, including the provider's default_tags.
- `url` (String)
